news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: ₹2.46 loss per share (down from ₹0.69 profit in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹90.8b (flat on FY 2025). Net loss: ₹3.26b (down 458% from profit in FY 2025). Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 11% growth forecast for the Pharmaceuticals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 10% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 30% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Piramal Pharma Solutions Delivers 1,500Th Antibody-Drug Conjugate Batch At Grangemouth UK Facility
news.body: Piramal Pharma Solutions announced the completion of the 1,500th antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) batch at its bioconjugate development and manufacturing facility in Grangemouth, UK. With the 1500th batch representing a commercial oncology ADC batch, this milestone highlights the Company's capabilities and commitment to Patient Centricity. For over two decades, Piramal Pharma Solutions has been a global leader in ADC development and manufacturing. As the first FDA-approved ADC CDMO and the first CDMO to commercially manufacture an ADC, Piramal demonstrates proficiency in this segment. Piramal leverages this expertise to provide a comprehensive range of integrated ADC solutions from Grangemouth, spanning from proof-of-concept studies to clinical- and commercial-scale manufacturing. news.title: Piramal Pharma Solutions Achieves Regulatory Compliance for Nitrosamine Impurities
news.body: Piramal Pharma Solutions announced the successful completion of its journey to compliance with global requirements for nitrosamine impurities in pharmaceuticals. Nitrosamine are unintended carcinogenic byproducts that can be found in certain medications. This team played a pivotal role in the publication and continual update of the Position Paper, a centralized guidance document aligned with the latest regulatory expectations. By clearly defining roles and responsibilities, the Position Paper enabled site teams to adapt to the challenges and changes associated with the new requirements.
